collection.title: BMW M4 Saloon 2014 to 2020 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a BMW M4 2014 - 2020 model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
